sections.title: Phoenix Industry Specializations
sections.description: ClickMasters builds AI specifically for Phoenix's dominant and growing industry sectors.

items.title: Semiconductor Manufacturing (Phoenix's Rising Industry)
items.description: Phoenix is becoming one of the US's most important semiconductor manufacturing locations. Intel's Chandler campus (one of the company's most advanced US fabs), TSMC's North Phoenix fabs (direct US government-supported investment), and the ecosystem of suppliers and equipment makers following them creates substantial semiconductor AI demand. ClickMasters builds semiconductor manufacturing AI including: computer vision for wafer defect detection and die classification; yield prediction ML from process parameter data; equipment anomaly detection and predictive maintenance from fab sensor data; process parameter optimization for etch, deposition, and lithography unit operations.
items.label: Semiconductor

items.title: Financial Services and Banking
items.description: JPMorgan Chase's large Phoenix campus (one of the largest US employee concentrations outside Wall Street), Wells Fargo operations, Nationwide (Scottsdale HQ), and Arizona's significant insurance sector. Fraud detection, credit risk, claims analytics, and financial document intelligence for Phoenix's financial sector.
items.label: Financial Services

items.title: Healthcare
items.description: Banner Health (Phoenix HQ, Arizona's largest healthcare system), Dignity Health Arizona, HonorHealth, and the Mayo Clinic's Scottsdale campus. HIPAA-compliant patient risk stratification, clinical documentation AI, and revenue cycle optimization.
items.label: Healthcare

items.title: Logistics and Distribution
items.description: Phoenix's strategic Southwest location — at the intersection of major I-10 and I-17 freight corridors and with access to ports of entry from Mexico — makes it a key distribution hub. AI demand forecasting, route optimization, and warehouse analytics for Phoenix's logistics infrastructure.
